lead.headline: Kamara is questionable and two starters are on bye — the rest of the lineup is cleared
lead.deck: McLaurin got no designation on Saturday. It changes nothing: Allgeier and he tie at 12.4, and Allgeier stays in the flex.
lead.body: Start with the bad news: Alvin Kamara is questionable with his back after three limited practices and sits behind Kendre Miller anyway; Justin Jefferson and Ollie Gordon are on bye. Washington's Saturday report cleared Terry McLaurin — limited, rest day, limited, no designation — so the hamstring question that hung over the week is answered. It does not move the lineup. The projection cannot split McLaurin and Allgeier, 12.4 each, and Allgeier is Arizona's lead back with Jeremiyah Love out. He plays Sunday; McLaurin Monday, which keeps McLaurin as the cover if Arizona surprise anyone at 12:35. Elsewhere: Tampa Bay start an undrafted rookie with Baker Mayfield out, which suits Jaylen Warren's game script; Rico Dowdle is questionable. The lineup as set is the projection lineup, 127.0 against Bok-aneers' 112.5.
